title: Metadata corruption, duplicates and legacy installs
summary: dist-info stores installed distribution metadata. Missing or malformed METADATA, duplicate normalized names, legacy egg metadata and unreadable files can leave dependency visibility incomplete.
checks: Check bounded local metadata completeness and duplicates without importing packages.
Distinguish unreadable/corrupt metadata from a positively observed missing requirement.
limitations: RECORD hashes and installed payload files are not audited; legacy/editable paths remain unknown.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
